newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: EU welcomes Philippine peace pact.
newsitem.headline: EU welcomes Philippine peace pact.

text.p: The European Union on Monday welcomed the successful conclusion of peace talks between the Philippines and the Moro National Liberation Front.

"The European Union expresses the hope that the agreement concluded in Jakarta and the establishment of the Southern Philippines Council for Peace and Development will lead to a general reconciliation and usher in a new era of peace and prosperity," current EU president Ireland said in a statement.
Moslem rebels and the Philippine government signed a peace pact on Monday ending 24 years of war in the south that killed 125,000 people.
The accord, signed at a ceremony in the presidential palace in Manila, took four years to negotiate with the help of Islamic nations led by Indonesia.
